text_block_list.text:
With all the races concluded, we set aside 
time to reflect on her record once again.
choice_data_list:
To think you'd achieve eight crowns or 
more...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I am astonished as well. To think you 
could achieve such a magnificent feat...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to your resolute and 
decisive guidance, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun. For making me an 
Umamusume who leaves all others in the 
dust.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful for the good fortune of 
choosing you that day... no, of being 
chosen by you.
choice_data_list: It's the outcome of all your effort.
This is the result of all your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No—wait, if we keep going like this... 
we're going to end up praising each other 
endlessly."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we gracefully call it a draw and 
chalk it up as 'our' achievement?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, seeing as we've achieved results, 
don't you think some kind of reward is in 
order?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And naturally, the reward must be one fit 
for the achievement of the century.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so? To tell you the truth, 
my dear Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—I can't think of anything either. 
Haha... Rewarding oneself is a difficult 
task indeed.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, we have plenty of time. Why 
don't the two of us put our heads together 
and take things slow?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Because that time itself will surely be a 
worthy reward.
